description: This file implements a WebSocket client for real-time communication within a Flutter application, managing connection lifecycle, heartbeat pings, auto-reconnection with jitter backoff, message handling, and session resumption.

classes.name: WsClient
classes.description: A WebSocket client class providing connection management, heartbeat, reconnection, message streaming, and session handling for a Flutter app.

methods.name: _buildUri
methods.description: Constructs the WebSocket URL with optional token and session ID query parameters.

methods.name: _startHeartbeat
methods.description: Begins periodic pings to keep connection alive.

methods.name: _connectOnce
methods.description: Performs a single attempt to establish a WebSocket connection, setting up message handlers, heartbeat, and session resumption.

methods.name: _scheduleReconnect
methods.description: Schedules a reconnect attempt with jitter exponential backoff when connection drops.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Public method to initiate WebSocket connection and start heartbeat, with auto-reconnect on failure.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Public method to disconnect gracefully and stop reconnect attempts.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a JSON-encoded message over the WebSocket.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Sends an authentication message with the current token.

methods.name: subscribeMatch
methods.description: Subscribes to a match channel identified by matchId.

methods.name: joinLobby
methods.description: Stub method for joining a lobby channel.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Releases resources, disconnects, and closes streams.
